debit.notes: Debit-card hotlisting page (verbatim): "HOTLIST THROUGH SMS - SMS KVBCARD XXXX BLOCK to 56161, 9643739643 (or) 9643999643 (XXXX = Last 4 digits of your debit card)" (page does not say the SMS must come from the registered mobile number); "Instant hot listing contact our HELPDESK at 1800 572 1916 (Toll free)"; hotlisting can also be done through the "KVB DLite" or "KVB e-book" mobile applications (download and self-registration required) or at any nearby KVB branch. Contact page, "Lost or Stolen Debit Card": helpline 1860 258 1916 (Local charges Applicable) and email customersupport@kvb.bank.in; "You can also contact the VISA Global Assistance Helpline if you are overseas" (no number published) and the loss must be confirmed in writing. Bank-wide: "Helpline (Domestic): 1860 258 1916 (Local charges Applicable)", "Helpline (Outside India): +91 44 - 66217600", "To report unauthorized / suspicious transactions / Loss / theft of card : 1800 572 1916 (Toll Free)", and the "National Cyber Crime Helpline Number: 1930" is mentioned on the bank's homepage footer. No net-banking channel is listed for debit-card hotlisting on the fetched pages, and no 24x7/24-hours label is published for these lines (the only "24 hours" label found is the corporate credit-card line 1800 419 6500). KVB's corporate site has migrated from www.kvb.co.in to www.kvb.bank.in; the old domain's DNS zone currently publishes no web records.

credit.notes: KVB Credit Cards (Retail/Corporate), per the bank's hotlisting PDF (verbatim): "Request to block & reissue of card can be made through following channels: Mobile Banking (Dlite)/ Net Banking: Credit Cards -> My Cards -> Block Card -> Select Reason (Lost/ Stolen/ Damaged) -> Block Permanently; Helpline Number: 1800-419-6500 (Toll free); E-mail: creditcardsupport@kvbmail.com (Only on bank working days 10:00 AM-6:00 PM)". Contact page, "For Grievances Related to Corporate Credit Card": "24 hours helpline numbers: 1800 419 6500 (Local charges Applicable)", e-mail creditcardsupport@kvb.bank.in and customersupport@kvb.bank.in. Bank-wide lines also apply: "To report unauthorized / suspicious transactions / Loss / theft of card : 1800 572 1916 (Toll Free)", "Helpline (Domestic): 1860 258 1916 (Local charges Applicable)", "Helpline (Outside India): +91 44 - 66217600"; the homepage footer mentions the "National Cyber Crime Helpline Number: 1930". No SMS block keyword/short code is published for KVB-issued credit cards on the fetched pages; the net-banking route above is the PDF's verbatim menu path and the PDF names no portal URL. The bank's homepage also links a separate hot-listing FAQ for co-branded KVB SBI credit cards (/docs/sbi-card-hot-listing-and-reissuance-faq.pdf).

upi.notes: KVB publishes no dedicated UPI lock menu path; its UPI page lists the UPI apps as "BHIM KVB Upay" (Android: com.mycompany.kvb, Current Version 1.1.29 with SHA256 checksum; iOS: kvb-upay id1258079462, Version 1.1.21) and "KVB - DLite" (Android com.kvb.mobilebanking / iOS id1428536937), with "24 x 7 / Available for operations". In-app: per the bank's UPI Lite FAQ, "The UPI application will have the option to disable/delete the UPI LITE account. Upon clicking disable button, the balance funds available with the bank in LITE account shall be transferred to the customer's account."; for a lost mobile device, "Customer can approach the Bank of the account which is registered for the UPI & UPI LITE transactions to disable the UPI facility and to get the refund of the balance available (if any) in the UPI LITE." No UPI-specific helpline is published — the bank-wide lines apply: "To report unauthorized / suspicious transactions / Loss / theft of card : 1800 572 1916 (Toll Free)", Helpline (Domestic) 1860 258 1916, email customersupport@kvb.bank.in; the DLite FAQ's app-support fallback is "Alternatively you can call - 1860 258 1916 (Local charges Applicable) / Mail to customersupport@kvb.bank.in from your registered mail id." Caveats: DLite's "Card Control->Hotlist" and Card On/Off block only card channels (ATM/POS/eComm), not UPI, so hotlisting a card does not freeze UPI; no netbanking UPI manage/disable path is published — the internet-banking overview page's only UPI references are Digital Products menu links to the KVB UPI and KVB UPI LITE product pages; no UPI SMS keyword and no *99#/USSD channel appear on the fetched KVB pages.
